CLOSERINTENT-01: query evidence includes bounded attempts, load-aware timeout, reason and detail for keyed and legacy reads; exact closer ticket required for adoption; absent/null ledger repository metadata is compatible, while supplied repository/head context must match; missing identity columns project as null; expired successful empty-key proof or audited empty closer-ticket proof settles keyed no-dispatch; new intents clear predecessor IDs.
